prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone selfie portrait of an adult East Asian woman in an extremely tight close-up, showing mainly the face, shoulders, and upper chest. She has shoulder-length black hair with wispy bangs and one thin side braid, clear luminous skin, soft glossy pink lips, and large dark eyes looking directly into the camera. She wears transparent amber rectangular eyeglasses lowered slightly on her nose, and lightly touches the outer edge of the frame with one index finger while resting her hand against her cheek. Her expression is calm, relaxed, slightly playful, and intimate. Dress her in an oversized pale powder-blue crewneck sweatshirt with long ribbed cuffs pulled over part of the hand; include partial black printed lettering cropped at the bottom. Use a plain cool gray wall background, natural window light from the upper left, soft shadows, realistic skin texture, subtle hair flyaways, clear glass reflections, shallow depth of field, and a casual lifestyle cover-photo feeling. Composition should feel like a handheld phone selfie from slightly above eye level, portrait orientation 9:16, face filling most of the frame, no extra people, no watermark, no added text beyond the partial sweatshirt print.

promptZh: 创作一张逼真的竖屏智能手机自拍肖像，主角为 一位成年东亚女性，采用极近距离特写，主要展示面部、肩膀和上胸部。她留着 齐肩黑发，配有空气刘海和一根细侧辫，皮肤清透有光泽，嘴唇呈柔和的粉色光泽，深邃的大眼睛直视镜头。她佩戴着 琥珀色透明长方形眼镜，眼镜略微下滑至鼻梁，一只食指轻轻触碰镜框外缘，手部靠在脸颊旁。她的表情平静、放松，带着一丝俏皮和亲密感。让她穿着一件超大号的 淡粉蓝色 圆领卫衣，长长的罗纹袖口遮住部分手部；卫衣底部包含部分被裁剪的黑色印花字母。背景使用纯冷灰色墙面，左上方采用自然窗光，阴影柔和，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、细微的碎发、清晰的镜片反光、浅景深，营造出休闲生活照的氛围。构图应模拟从略高于视线水平处拍摄的手持手机自拍，竖屏比例 9:16，面部占据画面大部分空间，无其他人物，无水印，除卫衣上的部分印花外，不添加任何额外文字。
